title.zh: 可发布与可维护工具包

brief.zh: 接手者要从解压包运行一个金额命令行工具。交付参数、版本、退出码和错误说明，在独立Node进程重现正常和缺参命令，不能只在开发机截图。
brief.en: A user must run a small cents-based CLI from an extracted release. Provide arguments, exit codes, version output and a useful error path.

zh: 运行文档、变更记录和维护边界
干净环境按说明构建运行
示例命令、错误返回和测试重现
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
A missing amount must return usage and a nonzero exit code. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 仅开发机可运行或发布包漏依赖/配置应失败
failure.en: A missing amount must return usage and a nonzero exit code.

en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 接手者要从解压包运行一个金额命令行工具。交付参数、版本、退出码和错误说明，在独立Node进程重现正常和缺参命令，不能只在开发机截图。
仅开发机可运行或发布包漏依赖/配置应失败；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A user must run a small cents-based CLI from an extracted release.
Reproduce this failure first: A missing amount must return usage and a nonzero exit code.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
